lines.text: Why is this cell folded? Because the road ahead is narrower than the cell.
lines.phonemes: wˌaɪ ɪz ðɪs sˈɛl fˈəʊldɪd? bɪkˈɒz ðə ɹˈəʊd ɐhˈɛd ɪz nˈaɹəʊə ðɐn ðə sˈɛl.

lines.text: Meet a red blood cell: a dimpled disc, about seven and a half micrometers. It even pushed out its own nucleus. You have about twenty-five trillion of them: most of your own cells.
lines.phonemes: mˈiːt ɐ ɹˈɛd blˈʌd sˈɛl: ɐ dˈɪmpəld dˈɪsk, ɐbˌaʊt sˈɛvən and ɐ hˈɑːf mˈaɪkɹəʊmˌiːtəz . ɪt ˈiːvən pˈʊʃt ˈaʊt ɪts ˈəʊn njˈuːkliəs . juː hav ɐbˌaʊt twˈɛntifˈaɪv tɹˈɪliən ɒv ðˌɛm: mˈəʊst əv jɔːɹ ˈəʊn sˈɛlz.

lines.text: Follow it as the vessel branches, and branches again, into a capillary. There's no room to overtake, so cells go through in single file.
lines.phonemes: fˈɒləʊ ɪt az ðə vˈɛsəl bɹˈantʃɪz, and bɹˈantʃɪz ɐɡˈɛn, ˌɪntʊ ɐ kəpˈɪləɹi . ðeəz nˈəʊ ɹˈuːm tʊ ˌəʊvətˈeɪk, sˌəʊ sˈɛlz ɡˌəʊ θɹuː ɪn sˈɪŋɡəl fˈaɪl.

lines.text: You'd guess its surface stretches to fit. It can't. The dimples give it spare surface for its volume, so it folds into a parachute instead.
lines.phonemes: juːd ɡˈɛs ɪts sˈɜːfɪs stɹˈɛtʃɪz tə fˈɪt. ɪt kˈɑːnt. ðə dˈɪmpəlz ɡˈɪv ɪt spˈeə sˈɜːfɪs fɔːɹ ɪts vˈɒljuːm, sˌəʊ ɪt fˈəʊldz ˌɪntʊ ɐ pˈaɹəʃˌuːt ɪnstˈɛd.

lines.text: The tightest vessels are about three micrometers: less than half its width. And it keeps squeezing through, all its life: about a hundred and twenty days.
lines.phonemes: ðə tˈaɪtɪst vˈɛsəlz ɑːɹ ɐbˌaʊt θɹˈiː mˈaɪkɹəʊmˌiːtəz : lˈɛs ðɐn hˈɑːf ɪts wˈɪtθ. and ɪt kˈiːps skwˈiːzɪŋ θɹˈuː, ˈɔːl ɪts lˈaɪf: ɐbˌaʊt ɐ hˈʌndɹɪd and twˈɛnti dˈeɪz.

lines.text: Sickle cells lose the disc shape, stiffen, and can jam where oxygen is handed out. That dimple isn't decoration.
lines.phonemes: sˈɪkəl sˈɛlz lˈuːz ðə dˈɪsk ʃˈeɪp, stˈɪfən, and kan dʒˈam wˌeəɹ ˈɒksɪdʒən ɪz hˈandɪd ˈaʊt. ðat dˈɪmpəl ˌɪzənt dˌɛkəɹˈeɪʃən.

lines.text: Meanwhile, as you watched, your bone marrow made over a hundred million new red cells.
lines.phonemes: mˈiːnwaɪl, az juː wˈɒtʃt, jɔː bˈəʊn mˈaɹəʊ mˌeɪd ˌəʊvəɹ ɐ hˈʌndɹɪd mˈɪliən njˈuː ɹˈɛd sˈɛlz.

lines.text: Next: what this cell carries. Room for about a billion passengers.
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: wˌɒt ðɪs sˈɛl kˈaɹiz. ɹˈuːm fɔːɹ ɐbˌaʊt ɐ bˈɪliən pˈasɪndʒəz.
